concept: One hypothetical project update stays on a paper desk while the feedback draft beside it is revised clause by clause. The film is about making the next action visible. The colleague's reaction, reply and outcome are never drawn: they stay as empty slots.
world: A shared-work desk in a warm outlined story cartoon: the project-update message, the giver's planning note and a paper feedback draft, with two small faceless peers seen small or from behind. The desk is treated as a set of stations (inbox update, planning board, draft sheet, two-draft table, your own desk). A governing metaphor was tested and passed on structure, change, scale and safety: the draft is a paper sheet whose strips swap. No emotion, motive or outcome is acted, so the neutral desk is also the safe choice while illustrated acting is unresolved.
look: story-cartoon (illustrated): warm paper ground, flat fill with one cel shade, dark ink outline, hand-lettered underline labels, round shapes, wobble bubbles, paper panels, box marks, unfold entrances, pan camera habit. Classic explanation-led treatment is kept as a switchable alternative.

devices.what: The desk with the update message and the giver's planning note (old date), held as the home frame and returned to as the opening frame, changed at the close

The feedback draft as a paper sheet whose strips swap in place (slot): broad request, then situation and omission, consequence, request, then a separate discussion strip. The layout is held and only its state changes.

Two marking tools: a hand-drawn underline for the requested action and a box mark for the occasion. They are attached to spans and reused in the quiz, the practice and the payoff. This is the one accent.
Empty, unlettered spaces for reaction, recipient reply, future update, circumstances and follow-up. They are never filled, and they carry the 'not established' idea as objects.
Join device: the same paper sheet turns or hands off between stations. Cartoon-join fallback today: a hard cut or a black narration card. A black narration card marks the one turn.

join_material: Paper page turn for chapter boundaries (fallback today: hard cut or black narration card). Inside a topic the join is continue: the same desk, a new state, with a push in to the object when the camera enters it.

value_script.why: Pale open on warm paper. The something-wrong is the gap in the update, drawn in ink only.

value_script.accent: marigold outline only on the empty future-action slot
value_script.why: The accent is introduced as an empty outline, so it means 'the action to be named'. It keeps that meaning all film.
Black narration card for the turn: reaction and workplace behaviour are separate. One short dark break, then back to paper.
Return to paper for the delivery and context beat.
Richer middle: the draft is being built, with the update left and the draft right.

value_script.accent: marigold floods the request strip, action underline and occasion box
value_script.why: Colour flood at the mechanism: the request fills the slot that was empty. The recipient's slots stay uncoloured.

value_script.accent: marigold on the blank strip and anchors
value_script.why: Faded practice: the accent sits on the missing request.

value_script.accent: marigold on action and occasion only in the answer beat b27
value_script.why: Two-draft table stays neutral until the answer. The quiz has no highlight.

value_script.accent: marigold markers rest unused beside blank targets
value_script.why: Quiet, pale canvas for independent drafting, with no model on screen.

value_script.accent: marigold on action and occasion in the payoff
value_script.why: A lift at the close: the opening desk returns, changed. Only action and occasion are coloured, and the reply slots stay empty.

sections.treatment: Pale open and wide establishing, then close on the unsent draft. Presenter bookends (avatar) beside a workplace inset. Document-change story, with no acted reaction. Productive and calm, with one black narration card for the turn.
sections.world: Returning desk: update message on screen, planning note, unsent draft. Station changes: update, then draft, then the reaction/action slots.

beats.line: Wide establishing shot. The giver (small, back view) at the desk. An 'Imagine' label hangs on the inset. The update has a gap where the date line should be, and the planning note carries the old date. Presenter in the corner. Role: establishing with something wrong. Join: open.
beats.intent: alt: classic presenter plus message card, no figures

beats.line: Close on the giver's unsent draft: 'Please be more considerate' beside the update, with an empty marigold-outlined action slot. Role: the question. Join: push into the object.
beats.intent: allocation says template; the script hint said hybrid. Allocation honoured. alt: classic card

beats.line: Medium shot. The presenter indicates the existing draft and a second empty sheet for the viewer. The workplace inset stays. No agenda.
beats.intent: promise limited to a clearer draft

beats.line: Two separate empty annotation spaces, reaction and action, sit beside the recurring draft. Both are empty: no invented feeling and no viewer incident. Role: bridge. Station: the draft sheet.

The turn. A black narration card, then the two empty spaces held beside the message. Reaction sits by the conversation and behaviour by the future-action slot, with no causal arrow. Value break: dark.
beats.builder: title.card (black narration card) into the held slots
beats.intent: expressive only here; a calm state holds after

beats.line: Medium-close. A discuss tab slides onto the draft, and the recipient reply area stays empty. Context is an open margin annotation. Role: nuance.
Back at the update (wide). The future-action slot is held, separate from the empty reaction space. Brisk pocket rule that replays the desk's own images.

sections.treatment: Worked example on the held draft sheet. The strips swap clause by clause (hold the layout, change its state). Motion only on the three beats where wording changes, and the rest stays calm. The marigold flood arrives at the request.
sections.world: Draft sheet beside the update (left update, right draft). The planning board for the consequence. Close on the request strip.

beats.line: Chapter start. Close inspection of the same unsent draft and its empty action slot. No blame symbol and no expression.
Medium shot. The broad request strip swaps for the supplied situation and omission clause. Its omission span lines up with the gap in the update. A real draft revision.
beats.builder: bespoke motion scene (slot swap + shape fill join)
beats.intent: motion carries meaning; alt: classic progressive annotation

beats.line: The original update beside the revised draft. 'Substantiate' attaches to the update and 'interpretation' to the feedback, as two distinct objects. Role: caution.
Medium-close. The consequence line drops beneath the grounded account. A thread runs to the planning note, never to a thought bubble on the colleague.
beats.builder: bespoke motion scene (line drop, thread to planning note)
beats.intent: motion; the planning note is unchanged

beats.line: Close on a margin annotation beside the consequence line: 'concern or possibility'. A writing caution, with no change to the stipulated note.
Close. The request strip unfolds below the consequence and marigold floods it. The action underline and occasion box attach to their spans. The recipient does not act. Value break: colour flood.
beats.intent: payoff of the mechanism; alt: classic highlight

beats.line: Hold the request area large. Action and occasion markers sit on their spans. The reply space is empty while the viewer locates them.
A separate discussion strip below the prepared request, facing an empty recipient reply area. Not an agreement seal.
Wide. The same draft becomes a compact writing aid: intention margin, grounded account, request strip, discussion strip, next-action marker. Each is lit in spoken order, with no numerals.

sections.treatment: Faded practice on the same draft, with the request strip lifted off. The blank is the picture. Calm productive register, and the marigold sits only on the missing request and its anchors.
sections.accent_on: the blank request strip and its two anchors
sections.world: Draft sheet (past-problem lines only), then the strip restored in place.

beats.line: Medium. The request strip lifts off the draft, leaving a blank below the account and consequence. The original message and planning note stay.
beats.join: continue (state change on the held layout)

beats.line: Close on the blank strip below the past-problem lines. Do not fill it. The empty space names the missing job: the future request.
beats.builder: compare.two (past-problem lines vs blank future request)

beats.line: Two content anchors, changed delivery date and next update, attach to the blank strip. The model stays hidden while the viewer drafts.
Medium-close. The request is restored in the same strip. Action and occasion are marked beside their spans for comparison.
The two markers form one compact inspection tool on the restored request. The name 'clarity check' arrives after use.
Wide hold. The request strip beside the separate discussion strip and empty reply space. Three strips light in order: describe, request, discuss. They settle on the draft.

sections.treatment: The judgement: the same message as two drafts on one desk, equal in styling. The stopping quiz is silent and unmarked. The answer marks only action and occasion. Empty slots hold the limits. Peak energy comes from the quiz and the flood, with no acted outcome.
sections.accent_on: action and occasion in draft A (answer beat only)
sections.world: Two-draft table: a new station on the desk. Circumstances margin. Discussion strip.

beats.line: Chapter start. Wide hard cut to the two-draft table: A and B of the same message, equal styling, no marks.
Medium. A blank reply area and an unresolved circumstances annotation beside the drafts. No tick, no completed update.
Close on a centre of unresolved circumstances. Question tabs resources, authority and skills pop out one by one. None is selected.
Two equal draft objects. A shows action and occasion extracts, with its earlier prose as unlettered lines. B shows the broad request. No highlight, tick or cue. Stopping hold stays silent.
After the hold, A's action and occasion are marked. B shows 'consideration' facing an empty next-action slot.
beats.intent: addresses the listed wrong belief only

beats.line: Medium-close. The stronger draft keeps its markers. The reply and future update are empty spaces, and neither becomes an outcome.
The supplied discussion line prints as a quote below the judged draft, with an empty reply area. The section settles on a clear request with an unresolved conversation.

sections.treatment: Independent drafting on a blank canvas, with no model wording on screen. Nine beats of one canvas risk a run of near-empty cards (L-172). Builder families rotate, the camera pans across the canvas, and the shot size varies (wide desk, insert, margin close-up, dial, timeline). The world moves to 'your desk'. Calm productive register.
sections.accent_on: marker tools resting beside blank targets
sections.world: Your desk: a blank private sheet, a small hypothetical update reference object, margins that grow prompt by prompt.

beats.line: Wide. Camera flies through the model card into an empty private draft sheet on the same desk. Only short prompts. 'Now you'. Join: chapter.
beats.builder: hero.portal (through the model card to the empty sheet) + motion

beats.line: Medium. The empty draft with a small hypothetical project-update reference object beside it as an optional fallback. The model stays hidden.
Close on the margin. A small marker walks from a future-situation waypoint to the intended-change prompt, and the response space stays empty.
beats.intent: alt: classic prompt card; viewer supplies the content

beats.line: Pan to the evidence margin and grounded-account area. Situation and action-or-omission prompts sit together. No viewer observation is invented.
A certainty dial sits beside the consequence area, reading 'concern or possibility' when the viewer is uncertain. No motive is drawn.
beats.intent: motion only where the dial changes

beats.line: Medium. The action and occasion marking tools attach to the empty request area. No manager badge or command icon.
Wide-medium. A separate discussion area beside the blank request. The colleague's account is an empty space and feasibility stays open.
Close. The two marking tools rest beside blank underline and box targets on the private draft. No completed model, and no pass shown.
Wide. A follow-up note on a short time bar sits after the relevant occasion, separate from the conversation. Its action-occurred slot is blank, with no future update and no causal arrow.
beats.builder: timeline (one marked occasion, blank follow-up slot) + motion

beats.line: Hold the private draft with open role-and-procedure margin questions. No policy document or authority stamp. Calm.

sections.treatment: Calm payoff, with the opening frame returned and changed. The draft is prepared, not a conversation completed. Presenter closes beside the desk. The reply and outcome are not drawn. The value band lifts to light.
sections.accent_on: action and occasion in the final draft
sections.world: The opening desk, now with the prepared draft beside the update.

beats.line: Chapter start. Hard cut back to the opening update beside the viewer's blank draft, with the two familiar marker tools lit one by one. A quiet callback, not a test.
Wide to medium. The initial wording and the prepared revision sit side by side against the same update and planning note. They align without replaying the construction. Camera pan.
Hold the revised request with only its action and occasion marked in marigold. The discussion strip shows as unlettered lines, and the reply and outcome are empty.
Medium. Presenter outro beside the private draft and the project-update inset, with two markers and an open context margin. A blank follow-up note stays separate.
Wide close beside the opening desk, now with the prepared draft and compact marker tools. End before any recipient reply. No success scene.
beats.intent: stable classic composition kept as the alternative

alternatives: Classic explanation-led treatment: the same message cards, progressive annotations, practice, quiz and payoff, with the presenter and no character drawings. It is switchable per beat, and every beat line names its 'alt'.

Newer treatment: illustrated acting from designed rigs, with posed people and springy pops. It is not the default and is on hold until acting intensity is resolved. The current default uses document changes, not acted responses.
Join alternatives: page turn (default) or hard cut or black card at chapters.
open_questions: Illustrated acting intensity is unresolved: the outline plans small, faceless, back-view peers and no acted recipient response.

Catalogue props were not fetched at outline altitude. Whether document.page, compare.two, hero.hub, hero.meter, hero.journey, timeline and quote can carry the slot-swap and marker behaviour should be confirmed in pass 2, with bespoke fallback for b09, b11 and b13.
Allocation estimates about 429 s of film against a teaching-plan total of 480 s. Not reconciled here.
Beat b02 allocation says template but its script hint says hybrid. Allocation was followed.
The accent hue (marigold) is a proposal. It must be checked against the pack palette and the 'at most two saturated hue families' rule. Not verified.
Beats b32 and b34 use a journey and a dial as light metaphors for prompts and certainty. If they read as forced in the animatic, replace them with document.page margins.
